contract_english_overview: This agreement covers Vantage Data Cloud, Vantage Service Suite, Marketing Cloud, premium support, API/event processing, and implementation capacity for commercial, loyalty, customer recovery, and revenue-management operations. Spend is driven by platform subscriptions, event/API volume, support tier, integration throughput, and implementation services. The optimization question is whether SkyHarbor is paying for unused capacity, missing benchmark and price protections, and leaving service credits unclaimed.

contract_english_overview: This enterprise agreement covers Northgate Cloud consumption, Northgate Workplace E5, Northgate Insight Premium capacity, Northgate Copilot seats, and unified support for collaboration, analytics, and platform engineering. Spend is driven by Northgate Cloud commitment drawdown, licensed seats, premium capacity, support tier, and developer-tool adoption. The optimization question is whether SkyHarbor can rebalance cloud commitment, reclaim unused licenses, improve discount/price protections, and convert developer-productivity evidence into finance-confirmed value.
